summary: Attempt 2 judged the dead attempt-1 worker's committed grid repair (7 paths, never verified by the engine) against the task contract, found it sound and complete, and verified it end to end; no further code changes were needed. The 22 residual grid-census rows resolve as follows. FIXED (18 identities): chunk_abc (6 identities, the 'cannot be proven equal' class) and deconv3d (6) now extract through three new structural tie mechanisms in a100c/frontend/gridmodel.py -- the aligned-copy '.reshape(<tracked shape tuple>)' extent rule over any base, callable module-level lambda values with opaque config-dict reads memoized per (base, key) so they fill from identity-signed meta, and the quotient view-extent solve; grouped_mm (6, the 'loop-dependent value (total_tiles)' class) extracts through the identity-signed trip-count unroll (a meta/launch_meta constexpr the interpreter proves equal to the bare shape axis; an unsigned axis never unrolls -- the control refuses, named). REMAINING (4 identities, counted, genuinely untraceable, each refusal located and naming the untraceable input): gn_finalize (3 identities, 9 cases) -- its (n, g) grid axes appear only as the view-extent product n*g (verified: all four views are (n*g,), the only scalars are the shape-independent floats count/eps, and the payload carries no shape echo), so no bundle-visible quantity can serve either axis; grouped_gemm (1 identity, 6 cases) -- its tile-count sum iterates an unsigned case-shape axis whose single identity spans groups=3 and groups=4 cases, so unrolling either count would bake the other case's loop shape (the no-baking gate). Filtered compile sweep over the census operators carrying the residual rows: 18 artifacts + 4 located grid refusals = 22 identities, all sweep checks PASS (the 5-operator run exits 1 only on the vacuous repeat-cases-reuse control -- its only multi-case identities are the refused ones; the reported run adds add_base_max, the acceptance[1] no-baking spot-check operator whose two shapes share one identity, which exercises that control with 3 cache-hit repeat compiles). Executed comparisons under the declared QEMU endpoint at 1 and 4 workers with the cases' original policies: chunk_abc both shapes (fp32/fp16), deconv3d degenerate (1,1,1,1,1) fp32, grouped_mm both shapes -- all PASS. No baking: the probe's two shapes (3,40)/(3,70) share one identity and one bit-identical artifact and compute program counts 3 vs 6 at runtime from bundle reads (pinned nprog comparison), add_base_max's two shapes cold-compile bit-identical artifacts and cache-hit one another, the tampered-declared-grid and unsigned-axis controls refuse loudly, and the model-level census binds modeled == declared for all 2719 extracted of 2734 cases (15 refused: gn_finalize 9 + grouped_gemm 6, the two counted operators). The full test suite passes (41 files). NEW non-grid defect pinned for the next repair round: deconv3d's typical case (1,4,8,8,8) compiles through the repaired grid but its first execution mismatches per-lane (ox == 3 mod 4; 435 of 11520 elements at 1 worker, 398 at 4; the grid tile tail is intact and the degenerate shape PASSes -- attributed away from the grid), recorded in test_t037_repairs.py::check_t037_deconv3d_new_defect_recorded.
